subject: Private deployment intake — scheduling and compliance attendees
body:
From: Cara Zhou <cara.zhou@medipact.com>
To: lukas_meyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New: Private deployment intake — Redwood demo booking

Hi Lukas,

Thanks — I self-booked a demo via your site and saw the slot reserved for next Thursday at 10am PT. We are evaluating Redwood for a private on‑prem deployment (regulated PHI workloads). Two quick notes:

- We need the demo to include security engineering for our network/air‑gapped questions and legal to confirm data residency.
- Please include a SOC 2 summary and anything on patching/retention controls in advance.

Attaching: calendar invite (ics) from the booking confirmation.

Attendees: Cara Zhou (Security lead), Samir Patel (Legal counsel — copied), and an infra lead TBD.

Looking forward — 
Cara
Cara Zhou
Head of Security, Medipact Health
cara.zhou@medipact.com

---

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Cara Zhou <cara.zhou@medipact.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New: Private deployment intake — Redwood demo booking

Thanks Cara — welcome, and great to meet you.

Quick notes on scheduling and scope:

- I’m Lukas (SDR on this account) — Soojin (cc’d) is our Solutions Engineer who will run the demo and deep‑dive on on‑prem patterns.
- We can absolutely include security engineering and legal. To make the session productive, can you confirm whether Samir will join live or prefers a short pre‑demo call?
- Also: could you share the intended deployment topology (VPC‑peered, on‑prem air‑gapped, hybrid)? A one‑line reply is fine.

I’m attaching a short SOC 2 summary and our onboarding checklist — these are high‑level; Soojin will bring more detailed controls during the technical portion.

Proposed next steps:
- If the booked slot works for you, we’ll invite Soojin + our security engineer.
- If you prefer a different time, send 2–3 alternative slots and we’ll accommodate.

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf, onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive (SDR handoff) — Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.com

---

On Thu, 19 Aug 2027 08:14:22 -0700, Cara Zhou <cara.zhou@medipact.com> wrote:
> Hi Lukas,
>
> Thanks for the quick reply. Samir can join but he’s only available after 1pm PT on Thursday. Our infra lead is on Pacific time but may need to dial in from a conference room with limited audio.
>
> For topology: we’re evaluating a primarily air‑gapped on‑prem deployment with occasional data egress connectors to a secured gateway — we’d like to focus the demo on offline model update workflows, KV cache persistence, and how Redwood surfaces audit logs.
>
> Also: could you confirm whether Redwood runs any persistent outbound services during operation (we need to validate that for our security review)? If you have a short doc or diagram, that would be ideal.
>
> Cara

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Cara Zhou <cara.zhou@medipact.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New: Private deployment intake — Redwood demo booking

Hi Cara — thanks for the details, that’s super helpful.

We can absolutely tailor the demo to the air‑gapped / offline update flow and audit logs. To your question: Redwood Private deployments can run with no persistent outbound connections by configuring an offline model sync workflow; for full details I’ve attached a short network diagram and an FAQ page link below.

Suggested new slot to accommodate Samir: Thursday 1:30–2:15pm PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar update and include a brief 10min pre‑call for legal/network Q&A at 1:15pm PT.

Calendar options: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=alt-slot-1
Network diagram (stub): https://drive.google.com/file/d/network-diagram-stub

Let me know which option you prefer and whether we should add Connor O’Brien (Customer Success) to outline onboarding and procurement timing.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

---

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Cara Zhou <cara.zhou@medipact.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New: Private deployment intake — Redwood demo booking

Hi Cara / Samir — great, 1:30–2:15pm PT on Thursday works for our team. I’ve updated the invite and added Connor (CS) so we can start the procurement conversation and MLP (mutual next steps).

Action items before the demo:
- Medipact: confirm Samir’s calendar invite and provide any required NDA/PO template prior to the meeting.
- Medipact: share a one‑page network topology (can be redacted) for Soojin to prep migration/air‑gap demo.
- Redwood: Soojin will circulate the network diagram + short FAQ; Lukas will attach the SOC2 summary (sent) and Connor will prepare a 15m onboarding/commitment slide.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-7849

If anything changes, I’ll coordinate swaps. Thanks and looking forward to the conversation.

Best,
Lukas

---

[Attachment stubs referenced above: SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB), onboarding-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB), mutual-action-plan.pdf (PDF, 86KB)]
